headerDisplay: Homebridge bridge settings control whether Kobold accessories are exposed through HAP, Matter, or both. The plugin automatically adds Matter accessories when Matter external-accessory support is enabled for this bridge. [Documentation](https://github.com/himbeles/homebridge-kobold#readme)

token.title: Kobold Token
token.description: Your Kobold authentication token. See the documentation for token setup instructions.

language.title: HomeKit Language
language.description: Language used for the HomeKit service names and Siri commands. This does not affect Matter.

hidden.title: Hidden HomeKit Services
hidden.description: Hide selected switches and sensors from the HomeKit accessory. Matter clusters are not affected.

refresh.title: Refresh Interval
refresh.description: Use auto, 0 to disable, or a number of seconds (minimum 60). Matter auto mode polls every 60 seconds while active and 120 seconds while idle.

layout.title: Kobold Account
layout.description: Connection details used to discover your Kobold robots.

layout.title: Protocol Exposure
layout.description: Protocol exposure is configured in this bridge's Homebridge settings.

items.helpvalue:
HAP only: leave Matter disabled for this bridge.

HAP + Matter: leave HAP enabled and enable Matter → External Accessories in the bridge settings.

Matter only: run Kobold on a dedicated child bridge, disable HAP there, and enable Matter → External Accessories. Per-plugin protocol selection is intentionally unavailable on a shared main bridge.

After restarting, find each Matter pairing code under Plugins → Homebridge Kobold → ⋮ Actions → External Accessories. Matter requires Homebridge 2 plus working mDNS and IPv6.

layout.title: HomeKit Exposure
layout.description: These options apply to the HAP accessory when HAP is enabled for the bridge.

layout.title: State Refresh
layout.description: Control how often robot state is refreshed from the Kobold service.
